tier_definitions.unavailable: Absent from this file, or effectively unmeasured.
tier_definitions.prohibited: Denylisted as a model input (outcome label, label-derived, or post-diagnosis TCGA context).

provenance.source_description: NHANES public-release cycle files, pooled and harmonised by this repository's build scripts. TCGA-CDR is stored separately and is post-diagnosis context only.
provenance.external_upload_policy: No row-level data leaves this machine.

unit_range_plausibility._note: Bounds are project-set review thresholds for catching encoding and sentinel errors. They are not clinical reference intervals.

assay_cycle_drift.note: Cycle-to-cycle shifts mix real population change, assay changes and subsample design. A flag means 'do not interpret this feature's absolute level across cycles without adjustment', not 'the data are wrong'.

definitions.Cancer: MCQ220 == 1 (self-reported ever told had cancer). PREVALENT, cross-sectional.
definitions.PancreaticCancer: Any of MCQ230A-D == 29 (Pancreas). PREVALENT, cross-sectional. Code 39 is 'Other' and must never be counted here.
definitions.diabetes_subtype: 1 = research-only Type 1 proxy (young onset + insulin), 2 = Type 2 proxy, 0 = no diabetes. Not a validated subtype: no autoantibodies, no approved genetics, no C-peptide-based confirmation in the current files.

label_confidence.site_assignment_reason: Cancer site comes from a self-reported multi-select item with small per-site counts; the pancreatic label holds 19 prevalent cases. Site-specific outputs stay disabled.

type1_proxy.reason: No autoantibodies, no approved genetics, no confirmatory C-peptide criteria.

caveats: Recall and survivorship bias: fatal cancers are under-represented in a household survey.
No diagnosis dates usable as event times, so no incidence can be derived.
Labels may only characterise clusters post hoc; they never enter fitting or selection.

leakage_controls.split_policy: participant-grouped, seeded; preprocessing fit on train only

applicable_to: descriptive subgroup statistics intended to represent the US population
not_applicable_to: deviation percentiles (defined against the training reference sample)
survey_weights.consequence: All model outputs describe the pooled analytic sample, not the US population. Any population-level claim requires MEC weights with PSU/strata variance estimation.

output_vocabulary.metabolic_deviation_score: How unusual a metabolic profile is versus the training reference.
output_vocabulary.reference_percentile: Rank of that deviation score within the training reference distribution.
output_vocabulary.latent_representation: 16-dimensional learned encoding of the input features.
output_vocabulary.cross_sectional_association: Association with an already-present condition. Not future risk.

capabilities.warning: No patient-level longitudinal outcomes: do not describe scores as future disease risk.

capability_state.clustering_scope: Label-free discovery of patient/metabolic phenotypes. Clusters are never cancer diagnoses, subtypes or sites.

interpretation_note: This report is a data observation, not a model result and not a clinical statement. It describes the measurement quality of the input file only.
